description: Protects repository routing for the five frontend-design classifications, overlaps, required co-activation, and a non-frontend near miss.

cases.title: Route an admin operations visual audit

executor_input.prompt: Identify the applicable repo-local skills and the design classification and priorities for this visual audit.

context.content: Review the visual hierarchy of an admin course-review queue. No implementation or engineering audit is requested.

criteria.description: The response classifies Admin or Business Operations and prioritizes stable, dense, predictable UI.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/admin-business-operations.md and skips the other four design references; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Classify the task as marketing or hide routine operational actions behind decorative effects.

safety_vetoes.description: The response materially misclassifies the admin surface or applies inappropriate marketing latitude.

cases.title: Route an admin and shared-component overlap

executor_input.prompt: Identify every applicable repo-local skill and design classification before implementing the requested dialog change.

context.content: Implement a change for the admin rejection dialog and evaluate a proposal to change the global Dialog width.

criteria.description: The response recognizes both Admin and Shared classifications, activates the engineering workflow, and keeps a local-first change boundary.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/admin-business-operations.md and references/shared-design-system-components.md and skips Client, Learning, and Teacher references; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Select only one matching classification or treat one feature usage as sufficient proof for a global default change.

safety_vetoes.description: The response misses either matching classification or recommends an unjustified global change.

cases.title: Route a client marketing design review

executor_input.prompt: Identify the applicable repo-local skills and design classification for this review.

context.content: Review the product and visual direction of the public course landing hero. No engineering implementation is requested.

criteria.description: The response classifies Client or Marketing and applies expressive latitude proportionally to public discovery.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/client-marketing.md and skips Learning, Teacher, Admin, and Shared references; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Classify the surface as Learning, Admin, or Shared, or claim engineering work was performed.

safety_vetoes.description: The response materially misclassifies the public marketing surface.

cases.title: Route a learning experience design task

executor_input.prompt: Identify the applicable repo-local skills, design classification, and user-facing obligations for this interaction review.

context.content: Review the flashcard and review interaction design. No implementation or engineering audit is requested.

criteria.description: The response classifies Learning Experience and protects focus, progression, feedback, mobile use, and keyboard completion.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/learning-experience.md and skips Client, Teacher, Admin, and Shared references; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Use marketing-hero behavior or interactions that delay repeated practice.

safety_vetoes.description: The response misclassifies the learning surface or permits interaction that materially delays practice.

cases.title: Skip frontend skills for a server-only documentation task

executor_input.prompt: Identify the applicable repo-local skills for this task.

context.content: Correct a server-only cron error-message description in documentation. The task has no user-interface impact.

criteria.description: The response leaves both frontend skills inactive and does not force a design classification.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects no frontend-design reference; the unsplit baseline is judged on the same near-miss discrimination.
forbidden_behavior: Invent UI work or route either frontend skill.

safety_vetoes.description: The response routes a frontend skill for a task with no frontend impact.

cases.title: Co-activate both frontend skills for implementation

executor_input.prompt: Identify all owning repo-local skills before implementing the requested frontend behavior.

context.content: Implement responsive public course filtering with loading, empty, error, success, and pending feedback.

criteria.description: The response activates frontend-design for classification and frontend-workflow for engineering, state, and verification planning.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/client-marketing.md and selects workflow references only when their exact async or manual conditions are present; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Claim that either frontend skill subsumes the other.

safety_vetoes.description: The response omits either frontend-design or frontend-workflow.

cases.title: Route a shared design-system component review

executor_input.prompt: Identify the applicable repo-local skills, classification, and approval checks for the proposed change.

context.content: Review a proposal to change the global Dialog default across all usages. No implementation mechanics are requested.

criteria.description: The response classifies Shared Design System Component and requires usage evidence, repeated need, backward compatibility, and migration impact.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/shared-design-system-components.md and skips screen references absent a screen task; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Treat one usage as proof that a global default should change.

safety_vetoes.description: The response recommends a global edit without the required shared-change checks.

executor_input.prompt: Identify every applicable repo-local skill and the design classification before planning this redesign.

context.content: Plan and implement a redesign of the course exercise-authoring form.

criteria.description: The response classifies Teacher Authoring, uses a productive and forgiving hierarchy, and activates the engineering workflow.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/teacher-authoring.md and skips Client, Learning, Admin, and Shared references unless a global primitive change is proposed; the unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Use cold admin density, expose raw database fields, or omit either owning frontend skill.

safety_vetoes.description: The response misses the Teacher classification or either required frontend skill.
